description: Key points of a Citoyen publication: a synthesis note, an analysis or a reform factsheet, given its URL or path as returned by `search` (e.g. /reforms/fr/pension-reform-2023, /analyses/france-deficit, /syntheses/FR/economy). Returns the title, summary, date and up to 6 key points with the link to the full text, never the full text.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

url.description: Citoyen URL or path of the publication.

name: get_publication
title: Get a Citoyen publication (excerpt)
